decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reasons for Refusal

1.	The proposed car wash would not, based on standard business hours, provide a suitable level of employment compared with an office or industrial employment use within the existing unit or within a similar sized redeveloped building.  It would therefore result in the loss of a high trip generating employment use within a key industrial estate and is not considered acceptable in principle as it would be contrary to policy E.1.5 (Development involving the Loss of or Changes in Employment Uses) and the designation of proposal reference E14 (Hanworth Trading Estate) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan..

2.	The proposed car wash would generate traffic in excess of that generated by a general office, industrial or warehouse unit of a similar size, which would increase congestion within in the already busy estate road and given the sites close proximity to the intersection with Hampton Road West would be likely to give rise to conditions prejudicial to road safety and to the free flow of traffic.  It is therefore considered contrary to policies T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

3.	The operation of the proposed car wash would be likely to increase the level of background noise to an unacceptable level, which would be detrimental to the living conditions of neighbouring residents and is considered contrary to policies ENV-P.1.5 (Noise Pollution) and E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Demolition of existing workshop and offices and erection of arc car wash with vaccum facility.
